coverage_assessment: Nineteen literal bilingual, weekly, episode-specific and sector/province searches logged. Nine provisional candidates and one exclusion are persisted. Search coverage includes Panama City, Colón, Chiriquí/David, Panamá Oeste/Arraiján, Darién, Bocas del Toro and Ngäbe-Buglé, plus health, education, transport, agriculture, retirees and migration. Five candidate reports are body-opened for core events; four new health leads remain search-only after cache misses and ordinary DNS failures. All turnout thresholds remain unverified; Jan. 18/21 Causa Justa and Jan. 21-25 health-worker episode boundaries, physical departures and any cross-month continuity remain unresolved. Search date filtering was unreliable; no absence inference is made.
